issues.title: Egyptian airports raise alert levels amid regional developments
issues.title_en: Egyptian airports raise alert levels amid regional developments
issues.summary: The Egyptian Airports Company announced on Thursday that it had raised alert levels and operational readiness at all airports under its management to deal with any emergency regional developments. In a statement, the company said its chairman and chief executive, pilot Wael Al-Nashar, had ordered the heightened state of readiness and instructed airports to provide the necessary support to airlines in the event of flight schedule changes, alongside measures to rationalise energy consumption and spending. The announcement followed a meeting of the company’s executive committee, chaired by Al-Nashar, to review operational developments and passenger and flight traffic levels in light of the current regional situation, the statement said.
